name: RUMBLE_STRIPS_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-020-Q01 'Rumble strips' (2025, previously W5-Q09). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet, as the national W-series 10 + 20 at 600). Legend two lines d 110C (Series C, cap 110), gap e 50, the pair centred on the horizontal centreline as drawn (d above / e / d below the centreline): cap tops 289.27 and 449.27 (424.27 - 135 and + 25). Black on Class 400 retroreflective yellow. 2026-10-02 audit: the pair is not centred on the horizontal centreline: on the sheet the centreline is drawn at the bottom of RUMBLE (measured on the 200 dpi sheet: RUMBLE cap bottom 423 mm, centre 424.27; STRIPS cap top 477), i.e. d above the centreline, then e, then d. Cap tops 424.27 - 110 = 314.27 and 424.27 + 50 = 474.27 (were 289.27 / 449.27). The centreline position is read from the drawing, the sheet has no dimension for it.
